…どこの国でもああいう人は
いるんだね

records.english: People like him are everywhere, huh?

records.Japanese:
あ、あれ？
いつもはここで微笑んでくれるのに
ぼくのこと、嫌いになったの？

records.english: ...No, that's not it. You usually cheer me right up when you talk like that, but...

records.speaker: Mihwa

records.source_meaning: She wants something badly and has been thinking about it day and night.

そのことが頭から離れないの…

records.english: There's something I want more than anything. Lately I can't get it out of my head, day or night...
records.localization_note: Mihwa changes the subject to the object occupying her thoughts. Keep the day-and-night intensity.

records.speaker: Julian Lopes
records.context: Julian tries to charm Mihwa. She treats a date as a possibility and wants the crown. Once Julian rushes off, she teasingly invites Rafael to look for it as well.

いうのはいったいどんな物なの？
records.previous_English: Oh, Mihwa, that look doesn't suit you at all. What is it you want so badly?
records.english: Oh, Mihwa, that look doesn't suit you at all. What is it you want so badly?
records.localization_note: Julian says the troubled look doesn't suit Mihwa and asks what she wants so badly.

『新羅の金冠』っていうの
神秘的な名前でしょ？
とっても貴重なものなんですって

records.english: It's called the Silla Gold Crown. It sounds mysterious, doesn't it? I hear it's very valuable.
records.localization_note: Mihwa supplies the approved item name and describes its mystery and value as something she heard.

何だか高そうだね…ぼくに買えるのか
なあ。どこで売ってるの？
records.previous_English: Sounds expensive... Can I even afford it? Where do they sell it?
records.english: Sounds expensive... Can I even afford it? Where do they sell it?
records.localization_note: Julian jumps from the price to the practical question of where to buy it.

records.speaker: Mihwa
records.context: Julian tries to charm Mihwa. She treats a date as a possibility and wants the crown. Once Julian rushes off, she teasingly invites Rafael to look for it as well.
records.source_meaning: Mihwa has heard that it isn’t sold in shops and may be in Seoul.

それがね…お店では売ってないらしいの
京城にあるらしいって聞いたのだけれど

records.english: That's the thing. Apparently you can't buy it in a shop. I heard it might be in Seoul, though.
records.localization_note: Mihwa says it's apparently not for sale and that Seoul is only a location she heard about.

records.speaker: Julian Lopes
records.context: Julian tries to charm Mihwa. She treats a date as a possibility and wants the crown. Once Julian rushes off, she teasingly invites Rafael to look for it as well.
records.source_meaning: Julian echoes the shop information and suddenly thinks of a place he leaves unnamed.
records.Japanese:
お店では売ってない？　……！！！
そうだ！　きっとあそこだ！
records.previous_English: They don't sell it in shops? Wait... Of course! It has to be there!
records.english: They don't sell it in shops? Wait... Of course! It has to be there!
records.localization_note: Julian repeats the problem, then rushes to a confident inference without stating a location.

records.speaker: Mihwa
records.context: Julian tries to charm Mihwa. She treats a date as a possibility and wants the crown. Once Julian rushes off, she teasingly invites Rafael to look for it as well.
records.source_meaning: Mihwa asks whether he has an idea where to look.

records.previous_English: Oh? You have somewhere in mind?
records.english: Oh? You have somewhere in mind?
records.localization_note: Mihwa asks whether he has a lead rather than supplying one.

records.speaker: Julian Lopes
records.context: Julian tries to charm Mihwa. She treats a date as a possibility and wants the crown. Once Julian rushes off, she teasingly invites Rafael to look for it as well.
records.source_meaning: Julian tells her to leave it to him and vows to find the crown quickly and restore her smile.
records.Japanese:
ぼくに任せておいて！
一刻も早く『新羅の金冠』を手に入れて
君の微笑みを取り戻してみせるよ！
records.previous_English: Leave it to me! I'll find that Silla Gold Crown as soon as I can and bring back your smile!
records.english: Leave it to me! I'll find that Silla Gold Crown as soon as I can and bring back your smile!
records.localization_note: Julian makes an extravagant offer to find the named crown quickly and bring back her smile.

records.speaker: Julian Lopes
records.context: Julian tries to charm Mihwa. She treats a date as a possibility and wants the crown. Once Julian rushes off, she teasingly invites Rafael to look for it as well.
records.source_meaning: Julian says her smile is his source of strength, then asks for a date if he gets the crown.
records.Japanese:
だって、君の笑顔はぼくのパワーの
源だもん！　あ、『新羅の金冠』を
手に入れたら
ぼくとデートしてくれるよね？
records.previous_English: Your smile is what keeps me going! Oh, if I get you the Silla Gold Crown, you'll go on a date with me, right?
records.english: Your smile is what keeps me going! Oh, if I get you the Silla Gold Crown, you'll go on a date with me, right?
records.localization_note: The compliment turns into a question about a date if he gets the crown. Keep his expectation in the tag.

records.speaker: Mihwa
records.context: Julian tries to charm Mihwa. She treats a date as a possibility and wants the crown. Once Julian rushes off, she teasingly invites Rafael to look for it as well.
records.source_meaning: Mihwa teases him for getting ahead of himself and agrees only to think about the date.
records.Japanese:
まだ見つけてもいないのに
気が早いわね。いいわ
考えておいてあげる
records.previous_English: You haven't even found it yet. A bit eager, aren't you? All right, I'll think about it.
records.english: You haven't even found it yet. A bit eager, aren't you? All right, I'll think about it.
records.localization_note: Mihwa teases him for getting ahead of himself and agrees only to think about it.

records.speaker: Julian Lopes
records.context: Julian tries to charm Mihwa. She treats a date as a possibility and wants the crown. Once Julian rushes off, she teasingly invites Rafael to look for it as well.
records.source_meaning: Julian cheers, calls her answer a promise and says he will leave for Seoul immediately.
records.Japanese:
やったあ！　その約束、忘れちゃ
イヤだよ！さっそく京城に行ってくる！
records.previous_English: Yes! Don't you forget that promise! I'm off to Seoul right now!
records.english: Yes! Don't you forget that promise! I'm off to Seoul right now!
records.localization_note: Julian calls her response a promise and rushes off to Seoul. The joke depends on his interpretation.

records.speaker: Mihwa

records.source_meaning: Mihwa says she is counting on him, then realizes he has already left.
records.Japanese:
期待してるわ…って
もういないのね…
records.previous_English: I'm counting on you... Oh. He's gone already.
records.english: I'm counting on you... Oh. He's gone already.
records.localization_note: Mihwa starts to encourage him and realizes he has already left.

records.context: Julian tries to charm Mihwa. She treats a date as a possibility and wants the crown. Once Julian rushes off, she teasingly invites Rafael to look for it as well.
records.source_meaning: Rafael hesitantly gets her attention.
records.Japanese: あの…
records.previous_English: Um...
records.english: Um...
records.localization_note: Rafael hesitates before interrupting the private exchange he overheard.

records.speaker: Mihwa

あら、いらっしゃい
気づかなくてごめんなさい
records.previous_English: Oh, welcome! I'm sorry I didn't see you there.
records.english: Oh, welcome! I'm sorry I didn't see you there.
records.localization_note: Mihwa welcomes the newcomers and apologizes for overlooking them.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor

records.Japanese:
今のお話ですけど、『新羅の金冠』って
どういうものなんですか？
records.previous_English: That crown you were talking about... What exactly is the Silla Gold Crown?
records.english: That crown you were talking about... What exactly is the Silla Gold Crown?
records.localization_note: Rafael follows up on the object he just overheard her name.

records.speaker: Mihwa

すっごくキレイってことしか
覚えてないの

records.english: Well... Someone told me, but I've forgotten. All I remember is that it's supposed to be gorgeous.

なあ、FI

records.english: Huh... That's got me curious. How about you, FI?
records.localization_note: Claudio takes an interest and asks for Rafael's reaction by his substituted given name.

records.speaker: Rafael Castor

分からないし、ユリアンって人が
もう探しに行ったじゃないか

records.english: A little. We don't even know what it looks like, and Julian's already gone looking for it.

records.Japanese:
あら、あなたからのプレゼントでも
別に困らないんだけど
私、プレゼントする価値のない
女かしら？
